components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary Amber Brass action button with high-contrast dark ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E5A93C; color: #121316; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C88D24; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5F2EB; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tactile secondary control for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #2E323B; color: #F5F2EB; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #323640; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #3A3F4B; }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Walnut-toned surface container with subtle 1px structural border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1B1D22; color: #F5F2EB; border: 1px solid #262930; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #B5B0A4; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Obsidian input well with Amber Brass focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #121316; color: #F5F2EB; border: 1px solid #323640; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 44px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #E5A93C; }

narrative.overview: VirtualStand's visual identity is crafted for the warm, focused atmosphere of an evening board game session. Instead of cold, blue-tinted SaaS dashboards or generic indigo gradients, the interface draws from the physical materials of modern tabletop gaming: deep obsidian felt, dark walnut shelving, warm linen rulebook pages, and stamped amber-brass tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral dark surfaces (#121316 to #2E323B) that eliminate cold blue glare in low-light rooms.
High-contrast editorial ivory typography (#F5F2EB) paired with warm stone secondary copy (#B5B0A4).
Confident Amber Brass (#E5A93C) primary actions with dark ink labels (#121316) for unmistakable hierarchy.
Strict 4pt spatial rhythm and 44pt minimum touch targets across iOS, Android, and Web Localhost.

rules.name: The One Brass Token Rule
rules.body: amber-brass (#E5A93C) may appear as a solid fill on at most one primary button per active screen or modal section. All sibling actions must step down to ash-interactive or ghost treatments.

rules.name: The No Cold Indigo Rule
rules.body: Legacy AI-default colors (#0f172a, #1e293b, #6366f1, #4f46e5) are strictly banned across all screens and components.

rules.name: The Self-Sufficient Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headings stand on their own weight and spacing; never stack uppercase eyebrow kickers above a heading.

rules.name: The Single Boundary Rule
rules.body: Declare card boundaries once via tonal contrast and a 1px subtle border (#262930)—never combine thick borders with wide outer glows.

dos: Do import all colors, spacing, typography, and radii from @/ui/tokens and compose screens with @/ui primitives.
Do wrap scrollable tab screens in ScreenContainer so Web Localhost views stay centered at 920px max width.
Do maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast for all body/metadata text and 44x44pt touch targets on every pressable element.
donts: Don't hardcode legacy Tailwind slate/indigo hex values (#0f172a, #1e293b, #334155, #6366f1, #4f46e5) in any screen or component.
Don't place two primary (amber-brass) buttons side by side in the same card, toolbar, or modal footer.
Don't use thick colored left borders (borderLeftWidth > 1) or zero-offset neon glow shadows on cards.
